metadata.description: Wire format for the success response from `POST /v1/packages`: the coordinate accepted by the journal-first mutation and whether it was newly created. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/packages.rs` (`UpsertResponse`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/package_upsert_response/`.
The accepted package version's installable kind.
The accepted package's reverse-FQDN group qualifier.
True when the coordinate did not stand before this request (HTTP 201); false for an existing coordinate (HTTP 200).
